selectionReason: Complete first ten results plus two previously reviewed training examples (observed head rotation and repeated hand-behind-head posture). Selected output audit, not independent ground truth or random sampling.
review: Temporal source-PTS sheets plus native matched-track pose overlays; grade with the existing 0/1/2/unknown rubric and preserve uncertainty. No inference from a foreground actor when a background track was matched.
hypotheses: Final organization weights raw similarity and observation completeness, while computed pose similarity is metadata and initial classifier rankScore is not the final ordering score.
Observation completeness does not measure action or posture specificity; a fully visible generic pose can outrank a meaningful but less completely observed movement.
Returning camera angles can retain similar actor poses without being copied footage, so copied-footage exclusion alone need not remove repetitive results.
limits: These hypotheses require training-side evidence and validation before implementation. Do not fit thresholds, remove categories or calibrate probabilities from the frozen held-out top-ten judgments. Do not claim these twelve selected examples measure overall Precision.
benchmarkAccounting: Extraction overlaps only the already excluded functional uncached-01 run; no application rebuild. Three subsequent timing runs remain reserved for no heavy diagnostic work.
